data.title: Office Coordinator/Manager, Insurance Brokerage Services (Charlotte, NC)
data.description: Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the world address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Summary of Role: The Office Manager is responsible for ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of the office while delivering a positive experience for employees, clients, and visitors. This role coordinates day-to-day office needs, supports local leadership and serves as a key resource for facilities, administrative support, and employee engagement activities. The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, and service-oriented, and able to manage competing priorities and build strong relationships across the organization. Title and salary will be commensurate with experience. This is a full-time, in-office position working Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m., from our Charlotte, NC office, with some flexibility on hours as business needs allow. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Office Management Serve as the Regional office liaison supporting operations across two floors. Handle the coordination of team and client meetings, including tech setup and troubleshooting. Handle catering, logistics, supplies etc for requested meetings Provide meeting updates, manage directories, technology requests, supply ordering/ restocking. Help maintain a safe, secure, and well-maintained office environment, coordinating with building management on repairs, maintenance, and facility-related issues. Front-desk responsibilities: answer main line, greet visitors, ensure a clean and comfortable environment. Oversee incoming mail and the general office email account, ensuring communications are assessed, prioritized, and routed to the appropriate departments. Manage ordering and inventory of promotional items. Facilitate an upcoming electronic file transfer project as well as quarterly and other events. Facilitate the planning and coordination of office events, handling invitations, catering, supplies, vendors, and all related logistics. Other duties as assigned. Accommodate overtime where required; overtime is generally minimal. Operations Coordinate special projects, including an upcoming electronic file transfer initiative, as well as quarterly meetings, office events, and other business activities. Assist with service contracts by coordinating vendor relationships, reviewing service needs and terms, and identifying cost-effective solutions. Oversee office equipment maintenance, coordinating troubleshooting and contacting vendors for service as needed. Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Exceptional written, oral, interpersonal communication skills Experience with MS office suite including Copilot or other AI tools Excellent calendar management skills with meeting planning experience Ability to work both independently and within a team environment Technology proficiency: Comfortable troubleshooting basic technology and office equipment issues and partnering with IT professionals to resolve more complex technical needs Strong judgment and attention to detail, with the ability to assess, prioritize, and appropriately route information and requests Maintain professional demeanor, appearance, and communications when interacting with employees, clients, visitors, vendors, and other business partners Education and/or Experience: Insurance industry experience or knowledge of common insurance terminology preferred, as this role will assess and route incoming mail and communications to the appropriate teams- P&C and Corporate Group Benefits BA/BS preferred or other related training, education or business certificates. HS Diploma or equivalent required 3+ Years of office operations, administrative or office manager experience What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $60,000 – $70,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. 2590107

data.title: Benefit Coordinator
data.description: Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management, and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Job Responsibilities: This role offers an outstanding chance to grow your career in a dynamic and collaborative environment. As a Benefit Coordinator, you will work closely with industry experts and gain valuable exposure to clients and carrier contacts. You will: Support Account Executives in preparing insurance company proposal requests and organizing results, benefits, and rates in spreadsheets. Review client documents and summaries of benefits and coverage for accuracy under the direction of more senior team members. Build and maintain client files following office procedures. Answer administrative questions from clients and/or insurance company personnel such as ID card requests, claims, or billing questions. Provide direct contact with vendors or clients for clerical and administrative assistance. Support Account Executives during open enrollments administration. Organize client mailings, communications, or packets related to Open Enrollment, as instructed by the Account Executives. Complete and process group applications and Broker of Record letters. Build and maintain client calendars, ensuring timely completion of pending items and future deliverables. Support research activities concerning benefits and vendor/carrier products and services. Provide enrollment fulfillment during renewal and new business onboarding processes. Assist Account Executives in gathering form 5500 information, maintaining the 5500 calendar and tracker, and contacting carriers when necessary. Assist with client projects such as the implementation of new business, open enrollment processes, and non-discrimination testing. Resolve claims, billing, and eligibility issues with carriers. Keep client information updated in Salesforce according to instructions from Account Executives. Attend seminars and classes related to the department and take part in training about carrier products and systems. Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: To thrive in this role, you should possess the following skills and abilities: Outstanding ability to work independently and anticipate client and team needs. Strong time management and decision-making skills. Diligent follow-up skills. Clear and effective written and oral communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Education and/or Experience: An undergraduate degree or equivalent experience is required. Certificates, Licenses, Registration: License is generally not required at this level but may be required per state law. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture centers on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because ultimately, we exist to support others. The base salary range for this position is $50,000 – $60,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. 2591216
